history.overview: The Chamber of Flame channels fire‑aligned Discord energy for destructive rites and planar cleansing.

timeline.name: Flame Chamber Carved
timeline.description: Riftseekers carved the chamber into molten rock to harness elemental fire.

timeline.name: Discord Flame Infusion
timeline.description: Discord energy was bound to the lava channels, amplifying their destructive power.

timeline.name: Muramite Flame Assaults
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to seize the chamber to weaponize its fire.

timeline.name: Eruption Rites
timeline.description: Riftseekers conducted rituals that triggered controlled eruptions to cleanse unstable planar residue.
